feedback:
The private-card flow mostly follows the spec, but oversized form tokens can be echoed by FastAPI’s validation response, and fetch_pr ignores an explicit token whenever the caller supplies a client. Both need fixes before merge.

- [major] shipit/web.py:120 Oversized tokens can be echoed in the 422 response: The Form max_length validation runs before card_form, so a token longer than TOKEN_MAX bypasses clean_token and the sanitized error handling. FastAPI/Pydantic validation errors can include the rejected input value, exposing the submitted token in the response body. Handle token length validation in a way that never includes the value, and cover it with a test.
- [major] shipit/github.py:103 An explicit token is ignored when fetch_pr receives a client: When client is supplied, the code skips _headers entirely, so token has no effect and the requests use only the client’s existing headers. This violates the fetch_pr contract that a supplied token is sent and takes precedence. Apply the explicit token to requests made through an injected client, and add a MockTransport test for this call form.
